author: StewieFG
body:
This command was really useful and it was a donor perk and many regular walls players used to donate to be able to perform that command.
/surface basically was teleporting the user to the closet surface that is above the user.
It was,really useful in maps,with mountains and useful for sky bases for example in maps like Oz, etc. I really think you should bring it back and I think it will make walls players enjoy the gameplay more and new players to donate.

Opinions?
